request.prompt:
Rebuild image 2 as the next cinematic shot in the SAME PHYSICALLY CONSTRUCTED THREE-DIMENSIONAL CUT-PAPER MINIATURE WORLD shown in image 1. User requests an emphatic tangible 3D paper maquette, not an illustration. Image 1 is the material/lighting/fold/photography reference ONLY: do NOT repeat its close-up hand or composition. Image 2 provides the story, two characters, costumes, walking direction and landscape composition ONLY: discard its all-in-focus illustrative rocks, engraved detail and painted depth. Create a new convincing close-focus photograph of a handcrafted cardstock diorama, with rich sculptural volume and actual cast shadows.

SCENE: Vertical 9:16 immersive wide establishing view into a nighttime highland lagoon, broad still indigo water on the RIGHT. A narrow DRY ochre trail cuts diagonally from upper left toward lower right, above the lagoon on its LEFT bank. EXACTLY TWO small whole-body paper figures walk rightward along this trail, one behind the other: a Nasa adult woman leads, wearing a folded dark green shawl with individually cut fringe tips, white visible collar/cuffs, dark indigo ankle skirt, black paper hair in a simple low braid; an adult man follows half a pace back, wearing a blue-gray folded ruana with simple gray band, cream ankle trousers, plain gray head wrap. Both hold ONE plain dark rectangular paper staff EACH planted on the dry path. Exactly two staffs total. Each figure occupies about one fifth of frame height, both fully visible in the lower-middle part of frame. They are solemn figures within a large landscape. No one in water, no ritual yet, no magical effects or lightning. No giant foreground hand. Preserve left-to-right direction and blue/olive/ochre continuity with image 1.

ABSOLUTELY ALL SURFACES MUST BE PAPER SCULPTURE. Clothing made from 3–6 broad folded overlapping solid-color cardstock panels, slightly standing away from bodies, with clearly open hems and deep small triangular contact shadows. Faces and hands are simple folded ochre paper planes with layered cut-paper noses, ears and bent fingers, never realistically rendered skin. Each staff is a folded dark paper rectangular prism, showing a distinct lit narrow cut edge, same material as image 1. Shoes are little folded black cardstock shapes, touching the ground with precise shadows.

The landscape must visibly look HAND-BUILT AT MINIATURE SCALE. The trail edge exposes stacked thick die-cut ochre paper layers with stepped edges and vertical faces. Mountains are a modest number of large assembled angular charcoal cardboard volumes, with folded ridges and sharp exposed seams. NO dense tiny rock shapes, stone stippling, hand-drawn shading or printed contour texture. Sparse plants are separate bent cut-paper leaves standing several millimeters above ground and casting well-defined shadows. Near water consists of wide matte dark blue paper shapes overlapping at slight heights; edge shadows reveal physical relief, no mirror-like photoreal liquid. Distant ridges are successive freestanding cut-paper scenery pieces with real space between them. Pale mist is a few broad thin cut-paper ribbons placed at different depths, not cotton or realistic fog.

PHOTOGRAPH THE MODEL: camera placed inside the miniature set, viewing slightly down at the path, not a flat frontal collage. A close-focus 65mm lens with restrained shallow depth of field: both figures, nearest trail section and adjacent lifted water edges sharply focused; closest foreground blades slightly defocused; the back third of the lagoon and most distant mountains visibly OPTICALLY blurred. Rich low-key cool night ambience; large raking soft light from upper left produces clear lit paper edges, dark gaps, cast shadows behind every raised piece. Paper facets themselves remain unprinted, matte and simple; lighting makes the three-dimensional form. Tactile tiny fibers, subtle irregular hand-cut edges, very obvious thickness and folds. This is the look of a stop-motion set photographed between movements, not a digital illustration or a paper texture laid over a painting. No clay, plastic, ceramic, real fabric, real plants, wood grain, metal, human skin, CGI render, vector illustration, outlines, brushwork, painted atmospheric gradients. Fill the whole frame with the miniature world: no outer base, table, studio gear, display box, words, logos or watermark.
